correctness.rationale: Exhaustive run-composition bijections count balanced closed paths and unbalanced open paths for every profile. Binomial strict log-concavity determines balanced self-loop counts; explicit ratios isolate the unique maximizing transition count except the proven residue-1 tie. Endpoint-unbalanced maxima are strictly dominated, including the two small even cases; constant words are dominated. Stirling proves the asymptotic. Independent direct binary enumeration for \(3\le n\le18\) and all-profile partition checks for \(3\le n\le80\) match every claimed maximum and equality case.

value.rationale: For complete binary adjacent-pair counts the maximum preimage cardinality is the sharp worst-case ambiguity/list size of a natural string-reconstruction and finite-state observation channel. The finding determines it for every length, identifies all maximizers and their parity ties, and gives the exact leading collision-probability law. Counting possible outputs or any one fixed-type class does not answer this motivated extremal question; no unmotivated parameter slices or unproved downstream applications are used.
